mapper.update: UPDATE im_sessions SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, user1_unread_count = COALESCE(user1_unread_count, 0) + CASE WHEN user1_id = #{receiverId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, user2_unread_count = COALESCE(user2_unread_count, 0) + CASE WHEN user2_id = #{receiverId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND (last_message_at IS NULL OR last_message_at <= #{lastMessageAt})

UPDATE im_sessions SET user1_unread_count = CASE WHEN user1_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(user1_unread_count, 0) END, user2_unread_count = CASE WHEN user2_id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(user2_unread_count, 0) END, is_active = 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId}
